prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Generate a replacement premium anime game cover illustration using the supplied image as character, outfit, mood and scene reference. Landscape 16:9, no text, no UI, no borders. IMPORTANT RECOMPOSE with a much wider camera: full figure from entire hair/accessory tips to complete shoes, including both feet, all comfortably INSIDE frame. Highest hair/accessory point at 12% image height, lowest foot at 86%, at least 10% visible environment above and below subject. Character centered at 70% image width, figure occupies about 72% of image height, no body part or clothing cropped. Left 40% remains quiet environmental scenery for menu overlay. Maintain beautiful detailed face, same hair/eye colors and recognizable design, graceful proportions, warm gentle eye contact and companionship. Do not simply pad a small rectangular original; redraw continuous natural scenery and correct full-body perspective. High-end polished painterly anime illustration, refined fabric and atmospheric light. No extra limbs, no duplicate person. Hood: same long chestnut hair, blue eyes, elegant navy-and-gold cape uniform and harbor rigging, now standing full length on the sunlit pier in elegant boots. Preserve naval silhouette and warm maritime afternoon.

Extend surrounding sunny harbor sky and pier naturally to fill entire 16:9 frame. No inset, no borders, no UI, no words. Both boots completely visible and pavement below them. Do not enlarge the character again.
